guide.title: 综合解析
guide.analysis:
1.这篇文章真实的出题顺序是：第8题——第2题——第5题——第1题——第4题——第6题——第3题——第9-13题——第7题。所以，绝对不能按题号顺序做题，也不能按题型顺序做题（即做完第一种题型，再做第二种题型），这种阅读方法是错的。
2.因为List of Heading和Paragraph Matching是针对全文出题，所以要最后全部完成。（我知道这个因果关系听起来有些古怪，我可以花大篇幅笔墨给你证明，但知道你没耐心，所以此处省去10000字，你只用记住这个结论）
3.凡是和我在这篇文章解析中相悖的阅读方法都是错误的。包括神马先读文章后做题，神马平行阅读法、无词阅读法等，请统统纠正过来。
4.如果雅思阅读想考6.5分以上，这篇文章只能错3个题，而且只能是第4、6、7题。其他任一题目错，标志着你的阅读水平现在还处于6分以下。（我知道听起来很绝对，但背后是有很多道理滴）
5.我充分信任广大中国考生的聪明才智和举一反三的能力。所以《剑桥雅思8》中后面的文章，我就偷懒随大流了，像其他的《剑桥雅思解析》辅导书籍一样，按题号顺序给出答案分析就完事。但请你按我在这篇文章中讲到的《最快速雅思阅读》法，去练习所有的雅思阅读文章。熟练之后你一定会发现：“雅思阅读考试，一个小时太长啦！”

祝大家做题愉快。

list.note: 月圆月缺，盈亏；兴衰成败
adj. 基于时间的，以时间为基准的

list.en: Our conception of time depends on the way we measure it
list.zh: 我们对时间的概念取决于我们计量它的方式

list.en:
A.
According to archaeological evidence, at least 5,000 years ago, and long before the advent of the Roman Empire, the Babylonians began to measure time, introducing calendars to co-ordinate communal activities, to plan the shipment of goods and, in particular, to regulate planting and harvesting. They based their calendars on three natural cycles: the solar day, marked by the successive periods of light and darkness as the earth rotates on its axis; the lunar month, following the phases of the moon as it orbits the earth; and the solar year, defined by the changing seasons that accompany our planet's revolution around the sun.
list.zh: 根据考古学证据，至少5000年以前，早在罗马帝国出现之前，巴比伦人已经开始计时了，他们引入历法来协调公共活动，并计划货物的运输，尤其用来调节耕种与丰收。他们的日历基于三种自然周期：太阳日，根据地球绕着地轴自转产生的光亮与黑暗的连续周期来标记；太阴月，根据月球环绕地球的月相；太阳年，由伴随地球绕太阳公转引起的季节变化来定义。

list.en:
B.
Before the invention of artificial light, the moon had greater social impact. And, for those living near t the equatorn particular, its waxing and waning was more conspicuous than the passing of the seasons. Hence, the calendars that were developed at the lower latitudes were influenced more by the lunar cycle than by the solar year. In more northern climes, however, where seasonal agriculture was practiced, the solar year became more crucial. As the Roman Empire expanded northward, it organized its activity chart for the most part around the solar year.
list.zh: 在人造灯发明之前，月球有很强的社会影响。尤其对那些住在赤道附近的生灵来说，月球的盈亏圆缺要比四季的流逝更显著。因此，低纬度地区历法的发展相对于太阳年来说更受月亮周期的影响。然而，在从事季节性农业的更北方地区，太阳年则变得更至关重要。随着罗马帝国向北方扩张，它极大程度上根据太阳年来组织他们的活动图。

list.en:
C.
Centuries before the Roman Empire, the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days, with five days added to approximate the solar year. Each period of ten days was marked by the appearance of special groups of stars called decans. At the rise of the star Sirius just before sunrise, which occurred around the all-important annual flooding of the Nile, 12 decans could be seen spanning the heavens. The cosmic significance the Egyptians placed in the 12 decans led them to develop a system in which each interval of darkness (and later, each interval of daylight) was divided into a dozen equal parts. These periods became known as temporal hours because their duration varied according to the changing length of days and nights with the passing of the seasons. Summer hours were long, winter ones short; only at the spring and autumn equinoxes were the hours of daylight and darkness equal. Temporal hours, which were first adopted by the Greeks and then the Romans, who disseminated them through Europe, remained in use for more than 2,500 years.
list.zh: 在罗马帝国之前的几个世纪，埃及人已经用12个30天的月份明确标示了埃及的历法，在近似的太阳年上加了五天。每个十天的周期被称为黄道十度分度的特殊行星组的出现所标记。在日出之前，天狼星升起之际，尼罗河会发生每年最重要的洪水期，12个黄道十度分度可以被看到横跨了天空。埃及人赋予在12个黄道十度分度中的宇宙意义促使他们发展了一套将每个黑暗区间（之后，每个日光区间）分成12个相等部分的系统。这些期间被称为日光时，因为他们的持续时间根据随季节变化的日夜长短变化。夏季时间长，冬季时间短，只有在春分和秋分的时候日夜长短才相等。日光时，首先被希腊人采纳随后是罗马人将这个概念传播到了整个欧洲，并且使用超过了2500年。

list.en:
D.
In order to track temporal hours during the day, inventors created sundials, which indicate time by the length or direction of the sun's shadow. The sundial's counterpart, the water clock, was designed to measure temporal hours at night. One of the first water clocks was a basin with a small hole near the bottom through which the water dripped out. The falling water level denoted the passing hour as it dipped below hour lines inscribed on the inner surface. Although these devices performed satisfactorily around the Mediterranean, they could not always be depended on in the cloudy and often freezing weather of northern Europe.
list.zh: 为了追踪一天中的日光时，发明者创造了能靠太阳投射影子的长度与方向表明时间的日晷。日晷的对手，水钟，被设计在夜晚计算日光时。其中第一批水钟之一是个盆底附近有小洞的水槽，通过这个小洞，水可以滴出。当它降至刻在内表面的时间线以下时，下降的水位可以表示流逝的时间。虽然这些设备在地中海周围取得令人满意的结果，但是它们在欧洲北部的阴天和常常冰冻的天气下不总是可靠。

list.en:
E.
The advent of the mechanical clock meant that although it could be adjusted to maintain temporal hours, it was naturally suited to keeping equal ones. With these, however, arose the question of when to begin counting, and so, in the early 14th century, a number of systems The schemes that divided the day into 24 equal parts varied according to the start of the count: Italian hours began at sunset, Babylonian hours at sunrise, astronomical hours at midday and 'great clock' hours, used for some large public clocks in Germany, at midnight. Eventually these were superseded by 'small clock', or French, hours, which split the day into two 12-hour periods commencing at midnight.
list.zh: 机械钟的出现意味着尽管它可被调节以维持日光时，但它天然的适合保持时段相等。然而，因为这些引起了关于何时开始计时的问题，与此同时，在早期的14世纪，许多系统也改进了。这个把一天分为24个相等部分的方案根据何时开始计时而变化：意大利时间在日落时开始，巴比伦时间在日出时开始，天文时间在正午开始，用于德国的大部分公共时钟则在午夜开始计时。最终这些都被小型钟取代，或者法国时间，将一天分割成12小时的周期并且从子夜开始计时。

list.en:
F.
The earliest recorded weight-driven mechanical clock was built in 1283 in Bedfordshire in England. The revolutionary aspect of this new timekeeper was neither the descending weight that provided its motive force nor the gear wheels (which had been around for at least 1,300 years) that transferred the power; it was the part called the escapement. In the early 1400s came the invention of the coiled spring or fusee which maintained constant force to the gear wheels of the timekeeper despite the changing tension of its mainspring. By the 16th century, a pendulum clock had been devised, but the pendulum swung in a large arc and thus was not very efficient.
list.zh: 最早有记录的重量驱动机械钟是1283年在英国的贝德福德郡建造的。这个新型计时器的创新部分既不在减少的提供其原动力的重量上，也不在传递能量的（已经存在了至少1300年的）齿轮上；而在于被称为擒纵机构的部件上。在15世纪初期，尽管改变了计时器主发条的压力，螺旋弹簧和引信的发明也可以维持计时器齿轮的恒力。截止到16世纪，摆钟被设计出来，但是因为摆钟在很大的弧线内摆动所以不是很有效。

list.en:
G.
To address this, a variation on the original escapement was invented in 1670, in England. It was called the anchor escapement, which was a lever-based device shaped like a ship's anchor. The motion of a pendulum rocks this device so that it catches and then releases each tooth of the escape wheel, in turn allowing it to turn a precise amount. Unlike the original form used in early pendulum clocks, the anchor escapement permitted the pendulum to travel in a very small arc. Moreover, this invention allowed the use of a long pendulum which could beat once a second and thus led to the development of a new floor-standing case design, which became known as the grandfather clock.
list.zh: 为了解决这个问题，在原始擒纵机构基础上的变化装置1670年在英国被发明。称之为锚式擒纵机构，它是一个基于杠杆的装置，形状类似于船的锚。钟摆的运动摇动整个装置，因此它抓住并且放开擒纵轮的每一次咬合，并轮流允许它转动精准的数量。不像用在早期摆钟的原始形式，锚式擒纵机构允许钟摆在小弧线内摆动。此外，发明也允许了能一秒敲击一次的长钟摆的使用，这样导致了一种新型落地箱的发展，这就是我们所称作的落地式大摆钟。

list.en:
H.
Today, highly accurate timekeeping instruments set the beat for most electronic devices. Nearly all computers contain a quartz-crystal clock to regulate their operation. Moreover, not only do time signals beamed down from Global Positioning System satellites calibrate the functions of precision navigation equipment, they do so as well for mobile phones, instant stock-trading systems and nationwide power-distribution grids. So integral have these time-based technologies become to day-to-day existence that our dependency on them is recognised only when they fail to work.
list.zh: 如今，高精度的计时仪器为大多数电子装置设置内部时间。几乎每个电脑中都安装了石英钟以此来调节其运行。此外，不仅全球定位系统卫星上发射的时间信号能校对精密导航仪器的功能，同时也对手机，即时股票交易系统和全国配电电网有好处。这些日常存在以时间为基准的技术如果一旦失效，我们便能体会到我们对其的依赖性。

list.title: Q5解析
list.guide: C段第1句 定位词：civil；the months were equal in length
list.en: the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days...
list.zh: 埃及人已经用12个30天的月份明确标示了埃及的历法
list.stem: 文中：“the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days…”埃及人搞出的日历有12个月，每月30天。对应题中：the months were equal in length每月长度相同。所以做出第5题。如果你能同时注意到原文中municipal等于题目中civil一词，你会心中赞叹考官出题的严谨，更能确定答案的正确性。如此，恭喜你，我个人认为你的雅思阅读水平应不低于7分。

list.title: Q6解析
list.guide: E段最后1句 定位词； divided; equal halves
list.en: split the day into two 12-hour periods commencing at midnight.
list.zh: 将一天分割成12小时的周期并且从子夜开始计时。
list.stem: they divided the day into two equal halves.他们把一天分成两等份。对应E段最后1行中：split the day into two 12-hour periods.

list.title: Q7解析
list.en: ...and thus led to the development of a new floor-standing case design, which became known as the grandfather clock.
list.zh: 这样导致了一种新型落地箱的发展，这就是我们所称作的落地式大摆钟。
list.stem: 此句中的floor-standing case design对应题干中的cabinet shape，且该段第一行就出现了England这个代表国家的词汇。所以选English。

list.title: Q8解析
list.guide: A段 定位词; Public event and work schedules
list.en: …co-ordinate communal activities… to regulate planting and harvesting.
list.zh: ……引入……来协调公共活动……用来调节耕种与丰收。
list.stem: …co-ordinate communal activities… to regulate planting and harvesting分别对应第8题的public event and work schedules。这是词汇理解的功夫了。

list.title: Q9解析
list.guide: G段第2句 定位词：escapement; resembling
list.en: It was called the anchor escapement, which was a lever-based device shaped like a ship's anchor.
list.zh: 称之为锚式擒纵机构，它是一个基于杠杆的装置，形状类似于船的锚。
list.stem: 原文中的escapement对应题干中的escapement; 原文中的like对应题干中的resembling, 所以答案为 (ship's) anchor/ (an/the) anchor

list.stem: 根据该题的图，指的是个齿轮，所以答案为wheel一词。

list.question:
They devised a civil calendar in which the months were equal in length.
<space data-sid='583_0' data-number='5'></space>

analysis.title: Q5解析
analysis.guide: C段第1句 定位词：civil；the months were equal in length
analysis.en: the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days...
analysis.zh: 埃及人已经用12个30天的月份明确标示了埃及的历法
analysis.stem: 文中：“the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days…”埃及人搞出的日历有12个月，每月30天。对应题中：the months were equal in length每月长度相同。所以做出第5题。如果你能同时注意到原文中municipal等于题目中civil一词，你会心中赞叹考官出题的严谨，更能确定答案的正确性。如此，恭喜你，我个人认为你的雅思阅读水平应不低于7分。

list.question: They divided the day into two equal halves.<space data-sid='584_0' data-number='6'></space>

analysis.title: Q6解析
analysis.guide: E段最后1句 定位词； divided; equal halves
analysis.en: split the day into two 12-hour periods commencing at midnight.
analysis.zh: 将一天分割成12小时的周期并且从子夜开始计时。
analysis.stem: they divided the day into two equal halves.他们把一天分成两等份。对应E段最后1行中：split the day into two 12-hour periods.

list.question: They developed a new cabinet shape for a type of timekeeper.<space data-sid='585_0' data-number='7'></space>

analysis.title: Q7解析
analysis.guide: G段 定位词：cabinet shape
analysis.en: ...and thus led to the development of a new floor-standing case design, which became known as the grandfather clock.
analysis.zh: 这样导致了一种新型落地箱的发展，这就是我们所称作的落地式大摆钟。
analysis.stem: 此句中的floor-standing case design对应题干中的cabinet shape，且该段第一行就出现了England这个代表国家的词汇。所以选English。

list.question:
Match the event with the correct nationality.
They created a calendar to organize public events and work schedules.<space data-sid='586_0' data-number='8'></space>

analysis.title: Q8解析
analysis.guide: A段 定位词; Public event and work schedules
analysis.en: …co-ordinate communal activities… to regulate planting and harvesting.
analysis.zh: ……引入……来协调公共活动……用来调节耕种与丰收。
analysis.stem: …co-ordinate communal activities… to regulate planting and harvesting分别对应第8题的public event and work schedules。这是词汇理解的功夫了。

analysis.title: Q9解析
analysis.guide: G段第2句 定位词：escapement; resembling
analysis.en: It was called the anchor escapement, which was a lever-based device shaped like a ship's anchor.

analysis.stem: 原文中的escapement对应题干中的escapement; 原文中的like对应题干中的resembling, 所以答案为 (ship's) anchor/ (an/the) anchor

analysis.stem: 根据该题的图，指的是个齿轮，所以答案为wheel一词。

analysis.title: Q1解析
analysis.guide: D段最后一句 定位词 cold temperatures
analysis.en: Although these devices performed satisfactorily around the Mediterranean, they could not always be depended on in the cloudy and often freezing weather of northern Europe.
analysis.zh: 虽然这些设备在地中海周围取得令人满意的结果，但是它们在欧洲北部的阴天和常常冰冻的天气下不总是可靠。
analysis.stem: 当读到本段最后一句中freezing weather一词时，心中感觉有一丝凉意。很好，看看题干中的cold一词。

analysis.title: Q2解析
analysis.guide: B段第2、3、4句 定位词 geography ；farming
analysis.en: And, for those living near the equator in particular, its waxing and waning was more conspicuous than the passing of the seasons. Hence, the calendars that were developed at the lower latitudes were influenced more by the lunar cycle than by the solar year. In more northern climes, however, where seasonal agriculture was practiced, the solar year became more crucial.
analysis.zh: 尤其对那些住在赤道附近的生灵来说，月球的盈亏圆缺要比四季的流逝更显著。因此，低纬度地区历法的发展相对于太阳年来说更受月亮周期的影响。然而，在从事季节性农业的更北方地区，太阳年则变得更至关重要。
analysis.stem: 文中的"the equator", "lower latitudes", "northern", "northward"代表地点方位，对应题中的geography，而"agriculture"对应题目中的farming一词。当然，如果你不能精确确认考官的题目改写，这道题可以放一放，留到文章读完最后来看哪个自然段提到geography的含义。那时候，后面的自然段你已经读过，可以轻松排除一些段落，缩小选择范围，提升正确率。

analysis.title: Q3解析
analysis.guide: F段最后一句 定位词：pendulum clock
analysis.en: By the 16th century, a pendulum clock had been devised, but the pendulum swung in a large arc and thus was not very efficient.
analysis.zh: 截止到16世纪，摆钟被设计出来，但是因为摆钟在很大的弧线内摆动所以不是很有效。
analysis.stem: 发现怪异单词pendulum，心中大喜，选出第3题。本题难度：雅思阅读5分水平。

analysis.title: Q4解析
analysis.guide: E段第3句 定位词：simultaneous efforts；different societies；uniform hours
analysis.en: The schemes that divided the day into 24 equal parts varied according to the start of the count: Italian hours began at sunset, Babylonian hours at sunrise, astronomical hours at midday and 'great clock' hours, used for some large public clocks in Germany, at midnight.
analysis.zh: 这个把一天分为24个相等部分的方案根据何时开始计时而变化：意大利时间在日落时开始，巴比伦时间在日出时开始，天文时间在正午开始，用于德国的大部分公共时钟则在午夜开始计时。
analysis.stem: 此题需在文中找出大量出现大写字母、国家和地区处，以对应题干中的different societies，正好找到E段中的"The schemes that divided the day into 24 equal parts varied according to the start of the count: Italian hours began at sunset, Babylonian hours at sunrise, astronomical hours at midday and 'great clock' hours, used for some large public clocks in Germany, at midnight."
